selection_rationale: L1, L8, and L17 span depth with high, high, and modest semantic-mode local coverage; L13 is the prospectively chosen low-coverage semantic-mode control.

hypotheses.E0_native_path_is_exact: The native condition reproduces independent full-model logits with maximum absolute error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.E1_continuous_beats_discrete_end_to_end: Rank-four PCA has higher full-logit causal fidelity than four-centroid quantization in at least three of four layers.
hypotheses.E2_semantic_modes_have_finite_causal_cov: Semantic-mode replacement has positive full-logit causal fidelity in at least three layers and mean fidelity at least 0.05.
hypotheses.E3_semantic_binding_beats_permuted_modes: Real semantic modes have higher mean causal fidelity than every one of four frozen head-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.E4_local_write_fidelity_predicts_suffix_: Across twelve layer-method cells, local contextual edge fidelity and finite suffix fidelity correlate at least 0.50.
hypotheses.E5_logit_coverage_is_not_only_noise: Semantic replacement improves aggregate next-token CE relative to deleting the destination route in at least three layers.
